headline: Warden Rebound in Weathered Expanse as Colonials Breach Palantine Berm
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the northern sector has witnessed sharp tactical reversals alongside renewed breaches into formerly secure territory. In the Weathered Expanse, an aggressive Warden counter-effort overturned earlier Colonial advances, precipitating thirteen base shifts in two hours and leaving four bases in Warden custody, two with the Colonials, and three reduced to neutral ruins amid over 2,400 fresh casualties. To the northeast, the Colonial offensive against Palantine Berm has made its breakthrough; after enduring relentless assaults, the Warden perimeter gave way, yielding three strategic bases to Colonial forces across ten rapid transitions. Combat has also reignited on the Stlican Shelf, where five base exchanges centered on Briar and the Port of Rime leave Colonials in possession of seven bases against one Warden redoubt and one neutral gap. Callahan's Passage remains an inferno of unyielding attrition, swallowing nearly 4,400 combined casualties in two hours alone even as strongholds held firm without immediate change of hands. Along the Nevish Line and across Stonecradle, ground action has cooled following earlier ruptures, with front lines stabilizing for the moment.
